context: The pegs are A, B, and C from left to right. Move both disks from A to C. Each move transfers one top disk, and a larger disk cannot sit on a smaller one. The peg contents below are listed from bottom to top.
Green represents the large disk and blue the small disk.
description: Four frames show the initial state and the state after each of three one-disk moves. The player counts the initial frame as a step, so steps 2, 3, and 4 complete moves 1, 2, and 3, respectively. Below the last three frames, the completed instructions are listed with the current instruction highlighted in light gray.

frames.announcement: The initial state shows the two disks stacked on peg A.
frames.explanation: Initially A=[large disk, small disk], B=[], and C=[]. No moves have been made. The small blue disk sits on the large green disk. Move the small disk to auxiliary peg B first to uncover the large disk.
frames.key_state: No moves yet. From bottom to top, A holds the large disk and the small disk. B and C are empty.
frames.title: Two disks are stacked on A

frames.announcement: Move 1: Transfer the small disk from A to auxiliary peg B.
frames.explanation: Move 1: Transfer the small blue disk from A to empty peg B, exposing the large green disk on top of A. Now A=[large disk], B=[small disk], and C=[].
frames.key_state: Move 1 is complete. A holds the large disk, B holds the small disk, and C is empty.
frames.title: First move the small disk from A to B

frames.announcement: Move 2: Transfer the large disk from A to destination C.
frames.explanation: Move 2: The large green disk on A is exposed, and C is empty. Move the large disk from A to C. Now A=[], B=[small disk], and C=[large disk]. The small disk remains on B.
frames.key_state: Move 2 is complete. A is empty, B holds the small disk, and C holds the large disk.
frames.title: Next move the large disk from A to C

frames.announcement: Move 3: Place the small disk from B on the large disk on C to complete the transfer.
frames.explanation: Move 3: Place the small blue disk from B on top of the large green disk on C, keeping the smaller disk above the larger. Now A=[], B=[], and C=[large disk, small disk]. Both disks have been transferred.
frames.key_state: Move 3 is complete. A and B are empty. From bottom to top, C holds the large disk and the small disk.
frames.title: Finally move the small disk from B to C

summary: Set the small disk aside on B, move the large disk to C, then place the small disk on the large one. This takes three moves.
title: Moving two disks using auxiliary peg B
